hook: Your boat here floats through tiger territory.
title: Your boat trip goes through tiger territory
description:
The Sundarbans is the world's largest mangrove forest, shared by India and Bangladesh. Tigers here swim between the islands. A boat trip floats right through their home.

#Shorts #Sundarbans #Geography
